sentences.en: You're looking at a woman who was publicly silent for a decade.
sentences.zh: 站在你们面前的这个女人， 曾经在公众面前沉默了十年。

sentences.en: Obviously, that's changed, but only recently.
sentences.zh: 当然，这已经改变了。但是也只是最近才发生而已。

sentences.en: It was several months ago that I gave my very first major public talk, at the Forbes "30 Under 30 Summit" -- 1,500 brilliant people, all under the age of 30.
sentences.zh: 几个月之前，我在“30位30岁以下创业者”福布斯峰会上,贡献了我第一个公众演讲。1500位杰出的人， 年龄全部都在30岁以下。

sentences.en: That meant that in 1998, the oldest among the group were only 14, and the youngest, just four.
sentences.zh: 这意味着在1998年，这些人中年龄最大的只有14岁，而最小的，只有4岁。

sentences.en: I joked with them that some might only have heard of me from rap songs.
sentences.zh: 我开玩笑的跟他们说， 他们其中的一些人可能只在说唱歌曲里听说过我。

sentences.en: Yes, I'm in rap songs. (Laughter) Almost 40 rap songs.
sentences.zh: 是的，说唱歌曲里有我。近乎有40首。 （观众笑）

sentences.en: (Laughter) But the night of my speech, a surprising thing happened.
sentences.zh: 但是就在我演讲的那一晚， 一件意外的事发生了。

sentences.en: At the age of 41, I was hit on by a 27-year-old guy.
sentences.zh: 41岁的我被一个27岁的男生搭讪了。

sentences.en: (Laughter) I know, right? He was charming, and I was flattered, and I declined.
sentences.zh: 我知道（我还算有些名气），对吧？他十分迷人并且不断地讨好我，但是我拒绝了。

sentences.en: You know what his unsuccessful pickup line was?
sentences.zh: 你们知道他不成功的搭讪句是什么吗？

sentences.en: He could make me feel 22 again. (Laughter) (Applause) I realized, later that night, I'm probably the only person over 40 who does not want to be 22 again.
sentences.zh: 他说他可以让我重新体验22岁。（笑声）（掌声）我那晚才意识到我大概是唯一一个不想重新体验22岁的中年人。（笑声）

sentences.en: (Laughter) (Applause) At the age of 22, I fell in love with my boss.
sentences.zh: （掌声）在我22岁的时候，我爱上了我的上司，

sentences.en: And at the age of 24, I learned the devastating consequences.
sentences.zh: 然后在24岁的时候，我得到了毁灭性的教训。

sentences.en: Can I see a show of hands of anyone here who didn't make a mistake or do something they regretted at 22?
sentences.zh: 在场的人，有22岁时没做过错事或者没后悔过自己22岁经历的， 请举手示意好吗？

sentences.en: Yep. That's what I thought. So like me, at 22, a few of you may have also taken wrong turns and fallen in love with the wrong person,
sentences.zh: 没错，我就是那样想的。所以你们中一些人，就像我一样， 在22岁时做了错误的选择，爱上了错的人，

sentences.en: maybe even your boss. Unlike me, though, your boss probably wasn't the president of the United States of America.
sentences.zh: 这个人甚至可能是你的上司。虽然跟我的情况不同，你的上司可能不是美国总统。

sentences.en: (Laughter) Of course, life is full of surprises.
sentences.zh: 当然了，生活充满着惊喜。

sentences.en: Not a day goes by that I'm not reminded of my mistake, and I regret that mistake deeply.
sentences.zh: 生活中的每一天， 都在提醒着我曾经犯下的错误，我也为此后悔不已。

sentences.en: In 1998, after having been swept up into an improbable romance, I was then swept up into the eye of a political, legal and media maelstrom
sentences.zh: 1998年，在我陷入这段 不可能有结果的爱情之后，我卷入了政治、法律和媒体漩涡的中心，

sentences.en: like we had never seen before. Remember, just a few years earlier, news was consumed from just three places: reading a newspaper or magazine, listening to the radio
sentences.zh: 这场漩涡我们都前所未见。要知道，仅仅在几年之前，我们只能从三个地方了解新闻：读报刊杂志，听广播，

sentences.en: or watching television. That was it. But that wasn't my fate.
sentences.zh: 或者看电视。就是这么简单。但到了我这里， 就没有那么好的命了。

sentences.en: Instead, this scandal was brought to you by the digital revolution.
sentences.zh: 与以往不同， 那次丑闻是通过数字革命被公之于众的。

sentences.en: That meant we could access all the information we wanted, when we wanted it, anytime, anywhere.
sentences.zh: 这次革命使得我们可以在 任何时间、地点获得我们想知道的任何信息

sentences.en: And when the story broke in January 1998, it broke online.
sentences.zh: 在1998年的一月，事情曝光了，网上的相关报道铺天盖地。

sentences.en: It was the first time the traditional news was usurped by the internet for a major news story -- a click that reverberated around the world.
sentences.zh: 那是网络第一次取代了传统媒体来传播主流新闻，一个点击的声音响彻了全世界。

sentences.en: What that meant for me personally was that overnight, I went from being a completely private figure to a publicly humiliated one, worldwide.
sentences.zh: 对我个人来说，仅一个晚上过后， 我就从一个完全普通的无名人士，变成了一个全世界都在羞辱的人。

sentences.en: I was patient zero of losing a personal reputation on a global scale almost instantaneously.
sentences.zh: 几乎在一瞬间，我就成为了零号病人， 在全世界公众眼中彻底丧失了个人名誉。

sentences.en: This rush to judgment, enabled by technology, led to mobs of virtual stone-throwers.
sentences.zh: 科技使得人们草率的对我进行了评判，也使得很多暴民开始攻击我。

sentences.en: Granted, it was before social media, but people could still comment online, e-mail stories, and, of course, e-mail cruel jokes.
sentences.zh: 诚然，那时并没有社交网络，但人们仍可以在线评论，通过邮件转发故事， 当然还有不堪入耳的笑话。

sentences.en: News sources plastered photos of me all over to sell newspapers, banner ads online, and to keep people tuned to the TV.
sentences.zh: 新闻媒体将我的照片贴得到处都是，借此提高报纸销量， 为网站吸引广告商，为电视节目吸引更多观众。

sentences.en: Do you recall a particular image of me, say, wearing a beret?
sentences.zh: 你们还记得当时我的那张图片吗，就是戴着一顶贝雷帽的那一张？

sentences.en: Now, I admit I made mistakes -- especially wearing that beret.
sentences.zh: 现在，我承认我当时犯下了错误，尤其是不应该戴那顶贝雷帽。

sentences.en: (Laughter) But the attention and judgment that I received -- not the story, but that I personally received -- was unprecedented.
sentences.zh: 但在此事件之外，仅仅因我个人所引起的轰动和道德评价， 是史无前例的。

sentences.en: I was branded as a tramp, tart, slut, whore, bimbo, and, of course, "that woman."
sentences.zh: 我被打上各种标签，母狗、妓女、荡妇、婊子、贱人，当然还有，“那个女人”。

sentences.en: I was seen by many, but actually known by few.
sentences.zh: 很多人知道我，但很少有人了解我。

sentences.en: And I get it: it was easy to forget that woman was dimensional, had a soul and was once unbroken.
sentences.zh: 并且我也明白：人们不会记得”那个女人“也是多维的、是有灵魂的、曾经也是完好无缺的。

sentences.en: When this happened to me 17 years ago, there was no name for it.
sentences.zh: 17年前发生这件事的时候， 它还没有相应的专属名词。

sentences.en: Now we call it "cyberbullying" and "online harassment."
sentences.zh: 现在我们叫它”网络欺凌“或者”线上骚扰“。今天，我想和大家分享一些我的经历，

sentences.en: Today, I want to share some of my experience with you, talk about how that experience has helped shape my cultural observations, and how I hope my past experience can lead to a change
sentences.zh: 谈谈这些经历是 如何塑造了我对文化的审视，谈谈我是多么希望过去的经历 可以引起一场变革，帮助其他人

sentences.en: that results in less suffering for others.
sentences.zh: 少遭受一些痛苦。

sentences.en: In 1998, I lost my reputation and my dignity.
sentences.zh: 1998年，我失去了我的名誉和尊严。我几乎失去了所有，

sentences.en: I lost almost everything. And I almost lost my life.
sentences.zh: 甚至我的生命。

sentences.en: Let me paint a picture for you. It is September of 1998.
sentences.zh: 我来给大家描述这样一个画面。在1998年的9月，

sentences.en: I'm sitting in a windowless office room inside the Office of the Independent Counsel, underneath humming fluorescent lights.
sentences.zh: 我坐在一个没有窗户的办公室，在独立检察官办公室里，日光灯嗡嗡作响，

sentences.en: I'm listening to the sound of my voice, my voice on surreptitiously taped phone calls that a supposed friend had made the year before.
sentences.zh: 我听着自己在一通电话里的声音，那个电话是一年前通过窃听录取的，是一个我当时以为是朋友的人打来的。

sentences.en: I'm here because I've been legally required to personally authenticate all 20 hours of taped conversation.
sentences.zh: 我来到这里， 是因为我被法律要求亲自证明，这20小时的录音对话全部是真实的。

sentences.en: For the past eight months, the mysterious content of these tapes has hung like the sword of Damocles over my head.
sentences.zh: 在过去的八个月里，这些对话的内容，一直像达摩克利斯之剑（临头的危险） 一样悬在我的头上。

sentences.en: I mean, who can remember what they said a year ago?
sentences.zh: 想想，谁会记得一年前自己说的话呢？

sentences.en: Scared and mortified, I listen, listen as I prattle on about the flotsam and jetsam of the day; listen as I confess my love for the president,
sentences.zh: 我带着害怕与窘迫的心情听着，听着自己闲聊一些琐碎的事；听着自己坦白对总统的爱，

sentences.en: and, of course, my heartbreak; listen to my sometimes catty, sometimes churlish, sometimes silly self being cruel, unforgiving, uncouth;
sentences.zh: 以及感到多么的心碎；我听着有时狡猾、有时脾气暴躁、 有时愚蠢的自己，变得残忍，不愿宽恕，变得陌生；

sentences.en: listen, deeply, deeply ashamed, to the worst version of myself, a self I don't even recognize.
sentences.zh: 我听着，我对那最坏的自己产生了极深、极深的羞耻感，那是一个连我都不认识的自己。

sentences.en: A few days later, the Starr Report is released to Congress, and all of those tapes and transcripts, those stolen words, form a part of it.
sentences.zh: 几天之后，议会接到了斯塔尔报告，那里面包括了所有被偷走的 录音和文字记录。

sentences.en: That people can read the transcripts is horrific enough.
sentences.zh: 人们能读到原文稿， 就已经十分可怕了，

sentences.en: But a few weeks later, the audiotapes are aired on TV, and significant portions made available online.
sentences.zh: 但是几周之后，录音在电视上被播报了，并且重要的部分都被传到了网上。

sentences.en: The public humiliation was excruciating.
sentences.zh: 公众的羞辱令我备受折磨。

sentences.en: Life was almost unbearable. This was not something that happened with regularity back then in 1998, and by "this," I mean the stealing of people's private words, actions,
sentences.zh: 生命几乎变得不可承受。这种事在1998年并不常见，通过这种事， 我是指偷窃私人的言语，行为，

sentences.en: conversations or photos, and then making them public -- public without consent, public without context and public without compassion.
sentences.zh: 谈话或者照片，然后将它们公之于众——在未经允许的情况下、在没有来龙去脉的情况下、在没有怜悯心的情况下公之于众。

sentences.en: Fast-forward 12 years, to 2010, and now social media has been born.
sentences.zh: 12年很快过去了，到了2010年社交媒体诞生了。

sentences.en: The landscape has sadly become much more populated with instances like mine, whether or not someone actually made a mistake, and now, it's for both public and private people.
sentences.zh: 像我这样的例子更加层出不穷，不论当事人是否真的犯了错误，甚至不论公众人物还是普通人， 都不能幸免。

sentences.en: The consequences for some have become dire, very dire.
sentences.zh: 这个结果对一些人来说 变得可怕，非常可怕。

sentences.en: I was on the phone with my mom in September of 2010, and we were talking about the news of a young college freshman from Rutgers University, named Tyler Clementi.
sentences.zh: 在2010年的9月，我和妈妈打了一通电话，讨论了关于泰勒·克莱门蒂的新闻，他是罗格斯大学一年级的新生。

sentences.en: Sweet, sensitive, creative Tyler was secretly webcammed by his roommate while being intimate with another man.
sentences.zh: 亲切的、敏感的、充满创造力的泰勒被他的室友在宿舍安装了网络摄像头，录下了他与另一名男子的亲密行为。

sentences.en: When the online world learned of this incident, the ridicule and cyberbullying ignited.
sentences.zh: 当这件事传播到网络上，嘲笑和网络欺凌被点燃。

sentences.en: A few days later, Tyler jumped from the George Washington Bridge to his death.
sentences.zh: 几天之后，泰勒从乔治华盛顿大桥跳下。他自杀了。

sentences.en: He was 18. My mom was beside herself about what happened to Tyler and his family, and she was gutted with pain in a way that I just couldn't quite understand.
sentences.zh: 他当时只有18岁。我妈妈对于泰勒和他家庭 遭受的一切感到十分悲伤，但当时我对于她的悲伤和痛苦并不能感同身受，

sentences.en: And then eventually, I realized she was reliving 1998, reliving a time when she sat by my bed every night, reliving -- (Chokes up)
sentences.zh: 后来我终于明白了，妈妈又重新经历了1998年的事，重新经历了那段她每个晚上 都坐在我床头的时期，

sentences.en: sorry -- reliving a time when she made me shower with the bathroom door open, and reliving a time when both of my parents feared that I would be humiliated to death,
sentences.zh: 重新经历了那段她要我 开着浴室门洗澡的时期，重新经历了那段令我的 父母担惊受怕的时期，他们怕我因受不了流言蜚语的羞辱

sentences.en: literally. Today, too many parents haven't had the chance to step in and rescue their loved ones.
sentences.zh: 而自杀。今天，太多父母没有机会干预或拯救他们挚爱的人。

sentences.en: Too many have learned of their child's suffering and humiliation after it was too late.
sentences.zh: 太多父母在得知他们孩子正遭受痛苦， 备受凌辱的时候，一切都太晚了。

sentences.en: Tyler's tragic, senseless death was a turning point for me.
sentences.zh: 泰勒的悲剧，他的死亡， 对我来说是一个转折点。

sentences.en: It served to recontextualize my experiences, and I then began to look at the world of humiliation and bullying around me and see something different.
sentences.zh: 它让我再次想起了我的经历，我开始审视身边存在的 羞辱和欺凌，并且发现了一些不同的东西。

sentences.en: In 1998, we had no way of knowing where this brave new technology called the internet would take us.
sentences.zh: 在1998年，我们根本没有意识到 这个叫做”互联网“的科技会将我们带往何处。

sentences.en: Since then, it has connected people in unimaginable ways -- joining lost siblings, saving lives, launching revolutions ...
sentences.zh: 从那时起，它以我们始料未及的 方式将人们彼此联系起来，找到失散的兄弟姐妹，拯救生命，发起革命，

sentences.en: But the darkness, cyberbullying, and slut-shaming that I experienced had mushroomed.
sentences.zh: 但是我经历过的黑暗、网络欺凌 和被骂做荡妇的状况，也在迅速增加。

sentences.en: Every day online, people -- especially young people, who are not developmentally equipped to handle this -- are so abused and humiliated that they can't imagine living to the next day.
sentences.zh: 网上的人们，尤其是那些还没有成熟到可以处理这些事的年轻人，每天都被指责、羞辱，以至于他们甚至不敢 想象如何面对新的一天，

sentences.en: And some, tragically, don't. And there's nothing virtual about that.
sentences.zh: 很遗憾，一些年轻人也的确 因此失去了生命，而他们的生命失去得没有任何意义。

sentences.en: Childline, a UK nonprofit that's focused on helping young people on various issues, released a staggering statistic late last year: from 2012 to 2013, there was an 87 percent increase
sentences.zh: ChildLine，英国的一个旨在帮助年轻人 解决各种问题的公益组织，在去年年末给出了一个令人惊愕的数据：与2012年相比，2013年有关网络凌辱的电话和邮件的数量

sentences.en: in calls and e-mails related to cyberbullying.
sentences.zh: 增长了87%。

sentences.en: A meta-analysis done out of the Netherlands showed that for the first time, cyberbullying was leading to suicidal ideations more significantly than offline bullying.
sentences.zh: 荷兰的一项综合分析首次指出，网络欺凌比线下欺凌更容易导致人们产生自杀的念头。

sentences.en: And you know, what shocked me -- although it shouldn't have -- was other research last year that determined humiliation was a more intensely felt emotion than either happiness or even anger.
sentences.zh: 而且，去年还有一项研究 更让我震惊，尽管我本不该如此，那项研究发现相比快乐或是愤怒，羞辱是一种更加强烈的一种情感。

sentences.en: Cruelty to others is nothing new. But online, technologically enhanced shaming is amplified, uncontained and permanently accessible.
sentences.zh: 粗暴的对待他人 已经不是什么新鲜事了，但是在网络上，技术的进步 导致羞辱被无限放大、缺乏他人的包容，而且永久可见。

sentences.en: The echo of embarrassment used to extend only as far as your family, village, school or community.
sentences.zh: 在过去，羞辱的传播 只会涉及到你的家人、村庄，学校或者社区，

sentences.en: But now, it's the online community too. Millions of people, often anonymously, can stab you with their words, and that's a lot of pain.
sentences.zh: 但是现在有了网上社区。成百万的人，通常是匿名的人用他们的言语刺伤你， 那种伤痛难以言表，

sentences.en: And there are no perimeters around how many people can publicly observe you and put you in a public stockade.
sentences.zh: 而且你不知道到底有多少人， 什么样的人能够公开地看到这些言论。

sentences.en: There is a very personal price to public humiliation, and the growth of the internet has jacked up that price.
sentences.zh: 被公开羞辱对个人的伤害很大，而且网络的发展加剧了这种伤害。

sentences.en: For nearly two decades now, we have slowly been sowing the seeds of shame and public humiliation in our cultural soil, both on- and offline.
sentences.zh: 近二十年来，无论是网络还是生活中， 我们都在文化的土壤里慢慢地种下了公开羞辱的种子。

sentences.en: Gossip websites, paparazzi, reality programming, politics, news outlets and sometimes hackers all traffic in shame.
sentences.zh: 八卦网站，狗仔队，真人节目，政治话题，新闻报道，甚至黑客， 这些都是羞辱的渠道。

sentences.en: It's led to desensitization and a permissive environment online, which lends itself to trolling, invasion of privacy and cyberbullying.
sentences.zh: 麻木不仁、放纵自由的网络环境，让网络煽动、隐私侵犯和 网络欺凌越来越猖獗。

sentences.en: This shift has created what Professor Nicolaus Mills calls "a culture of humiliation."
sentences.zh: 这种转变创造了 尼古拉斯·米尔斯教授所说的羞辱文化。

sentences.en: Consider a few prominent examples just from the past six months alone.
sentences.zh: 来看一些典型的例子， 都是过去六个月内刚刚发生的。

sentences.en: Snapchat, the service which is used mainly by younger generations and claims that its messages only have the life span of a few seconds.
sentences.zh: Snapchat，这种服务主要是年轻人在用，宣称它上面的信息只会保留几秒种。

sentences.en: You can imagine the range of content that gets.
sentences.zh: 你们可以想象一下这会涉及到哪些内容。

sentences.en: A third-party app which Snapchatters use to preserve the life span of the messages was hacked, and 100,000 personal conversations, photos and videos were leaked online,
sentences.zh: 一个Snapchat用来维持 信息寿命的第三方软件被黑客攻击了，这导致10万条私人对话、照片、视频 在网络上遭到泄露，

sentences.en: to now have a life span of forever. Jennifer Lawrence and several other actors had their iCloud accounts hacked, and private, intimate, nude photos were plastered across the internet
sentences.zh: 并且变得随时随地唾手可得。詹妮弗·劳伦斯和其他几个演员的 iCloud账户被入侵，私人的，亲密的，裸体的照片未经过允许

sentences.en: without their permission. One gossip website had over five million hits for this one story.
sentences.zh: 就被粘贴在了网上。仅这一个丑闻就使得一个八卦网站获得了超过五百万的点击量。

sentences.en: And what about the Sony Pictures cyberhacking?
sentences.zh: 想想索尼影业黑客攻击？

sentences.en: The documents which received the most attention were private e-mails that had maximum public embarrassment value.
sentences.zh: 最受关注的文件就是那些私人邮件，它们具备最大的公开羞辱的价值。

sentences.en: But in this culture of humiliation, there is another kind of price tag attached to public shaming.
sentences.zh: 但是在羞辱文化中，公开羞辱还被贴上了另外一种价格标签。

sentences.en: The price does not measure the cost to the victim, which Tyler and too many others -- notably, women, minorities and members of the LGBTQ community -- have paid, but the price measures the profit of those who prey on them.
sentences.zh: 这里不衡量受害者的损失，就像泰勒还有其他很多人，尤其是女人、少数群体，以及多元性别社区， 这些受害者的损失，而是衡量通过折磨他们所获得的利润。

sentences.en: This invasion of others is a raw material, efficiently and ruthlessly mined, packaged and sold at a profit.
sentences.zh: 侵入他人的私人领域是一种原材料，被有效地、无情地挖掘出来， 然后包装，销售，获取利润。

sentences.en: A marketplace has emerged where public humiliation is a commodity, and shame is an industry.
sentences.zh: 在一个新生的市场中， 公开羞辱成了一种商品，而耻辱成为了一个产业。

sentences.en: How is the money made? Clicks. The more shame, the more clicks.
sentences.zh: 如何赚钱呢？点击。越是见不得人的事，点击量就越多。

sentences.en: The more clicks, the more advertising dollars.
sentences.zh: 点击量越多，赚取的广告费用就越多。

sentences.en: We're in a dangerous cycle. The more we click on this kind of gossip, the more numb we get to the human lives behind it.
sentences.zh: 我们处在一个危险的循环当中。我们越多地点击这种八卦，我们对其背后当事人的 生活就越麻木不仁。

sentences.en: And the more numb we get, the more we click.
sentences.zh: 我们越麻木不仁，点击得就越多。

sentences.en: All the while, someone is making money off of the back of someone else's suffering.
sentences.zh: 自始至终，都是某些人在利用他人的痛苦来牟利。

sentences.en: With every click, we make a choice. The more we saturate our culture with public shaming, the more accepted it is, the more we will see behavior like cyberbullying, trolling,
sentences.zh: 每一次点击，我们都是在作出选择。文化中充斥的公开羞辱越多，我们越愿意接受它，我们就会看到更多的像网络欺凌、 网络煽动黑客入侵、线上骚扰，

sentences.en: some forms of hacking and online harassment.
sentences.zh: 诸如此类的行为。

sentences.en: Why? Because they all have humiliation at their cores.
sentences.zh: 为什么？因为它们的核心都是羞辱。

sentences.en: This behavior is a symptom of the culture we've created.
sentences.zh: 这些行为是我们创造的文化的一种病症。

sentences.en: Just think about it. Changing behavior begins with evolving beliefs.
sentences.zh: 想一想吧。从改变信仰开始，改变我们的行为。

sentences.en: We've seen that to be true with racism, homophobia and plenty of other biases, today and in the past.
sentences.zh: 过去和如今的很多种族歧视、 同性歧视及其他歧视，都可以通过这样的方式来消除。

sentences.en: As we've changed beliefs about same-sex marriage, more people have been offered equal freedoms.
sentences.zh: 随着我们对同性结婚看法的改变，更多的人被赋予了平等的自由。

sentences.en: When we began valuing sustainability, more people began to recycle.
sentences.zh: 当我们意识到了可持续性的重要之处，更多的人开始已经 把目光转向了循环利用。

sentences.en: So as far as our culture of humiliation goes, what we need is a cultural revolution.
sentences.zh: 现在，随着羞辱文化的发展，我们需要的是文化的变革。

sentences.en: Public shaming as a blood sport has to stop, and it's time for an intervention on the internet and in our culture.
sentences.zh: 公开羞辱这种流血的文化 是时候该停止了，无论是互联网还是我们的文化， 都是时候对其进行干预了。

sentences.en: The shift begins with something simple, but it's not easy.
sentences.zh: 转变可以从简单的事开始， 但是这又谈何容易。

sentences.en: We need to return to a long-held value of compassion, compassion and empathy.
sentences.zh: 我们需要拾回怜悯的价值观—— 同情心和同理心。

sentences.en: Online, we've got a compassion deficit, an empathy crisis.
sentences.zh: 在网络上，出现了同情心匮乏和同理心危机。

sentences.en: Researcher Brené Brown said, and I quote, "Shame can't survive empathy."
sentences.zh: 引用研究人员布林·布朗的话，“耻辱在同理心下无法存活。”

sentences.en: Shame cannot survive empathy. I've seen some very dark days in my life.
sentences.zh: 耻辱在同理心下无法存活。我的生命中有过一段十分黑暗的日子，

sentences.en: It was the compassion and empathy from my family, friends, professionals and sometimes even strangers that saved me.
sentences.zh: 而来自家人、朋友、专家， 甚至一些陌生人的同情心和同理心拯救了我，

sentences.en: Even empathy from one person can make a difference.
sentences.zh: 来自哪怕只有一个人的同理心， 都会是莫大的安慰。

sentences.en: The theory of minority influence, proposed by social psychologist Serge Moscovici, says that even in small numbers, when there's consistency over time, change can happen.
sentences.zh: 社会学家谢尔盖·莫斯科维奇所提出的小众影响理论认为，哪怕是很小的一部分群体的行为，只要能坚持下去，也会引起变化。

sentences.en: In the online world, we can foster minority influence by becoming upstanders.
sentences.zh: 在网络世界，我们可以通过以身作则，来培育小众影响力。

sentences.en: To become an upstander means instead of bystander apathy, we can post a positive comment for someone or report a bullying situation.
sentences.zh: 以身作则的意思是说， 并不只是同情的旁观，而是要发表积极的评论支持受害者， 或举报网络欺凌的现象。

sentences.en: Trust me, compassionate comments help abate the negativity.
sentences.zh: 相信我，富有同情心的评论 可以帮助减少消极影响。

sentences.en: We can also counteract the culture by supporting organizations that deal with these kinds of issues, like the Tyler Clementi Foundation in the US; in the UK, there's Anti-Bullying Pro;
sentences.zh: 我们还可以通过支持 处理这类问题的组织机构来对抗这种羞辱文化，比如，美国有泰勒·克莱门蒂基金会，英国有反欺凌项目，

sentences.en: and in Australia, there's PROJECT ROCKIT.
sentences.zh: 澳大利亚有Rockit项目。

sentences.en: We talk a lot about our right to freedom of expression.
sentences.zh: 我们一直在谈论言论自由的权利，

sentences.en: But we need to talk more about our responsibility to freedom of expression.
sentences.zh: 但是我们也需要更多地谈到我们在言论自由方面的义务。

sentences.en: We all want to be heard, but let's acknowledge the difference between speaking up with intention and speaking up for attention.
sentences.zh: 我们都想被听到，但是我们要区别怀有意图的发声，和想被关注的发声。

sentences.en: The internet is the superhighway for the id.
sentences.zh: 互联网是个人表达自我的高速公路，

sentences.en: But online, showing empathy to others benefits us all and helps create a safer and better world.
sentences.zh: 不过在网上，对他人表现出同理心会使我们每个人受益， 并且会帮助创造更安全、更美好的世界。

sentences.en: We need to communicate online with compassion, consume news with compassion and click with compassion.
sentences.zh: 我们需要怀着同情心在网上交流，怀着同情心阅读新闻，怀着同情心进行点击。

sentences.en: Just imagine walking a mile in someone else's headline.
sentences.zh: 想象一下自己活在别人 新闻头条里的情形吧。

sentences.en: I'd like to end on a personal note. In the past nine months, the question I've been asked the most is "Why?"
sentences.zh: 最后，我想以一些个人感想 结束今天的演讲。在过去的九个月里，我被问的最多的问题就是“为什么”。

sentences.en: Why now? Why was I sticking my head above the parapet?
sentences.zh: 为什么是现在？ 为什么选择站出来面对大众？

sentences.en: You can read between the lines in those questions, and the answer has nothing to do with politics.
sentences.zh: 你们应该听出这些问题的言外之意，答案和政治无关。

sentences.en: The top-note answer was and is "Because it's time."
sentences.zh: 我的回答从来都是，因为是时候了：

sentences.en: Time to stop tiptoeing around my past, time to stop living a life of opprobrium and time to take back my narrative.
sentences.zh: 是时候不在为曾经的过失 而小心翼翼的生活，是时候停止那种充满羞辱的生活，是时候找回我的人生方向。

sentences.en: It's also not just about saving myself. Anyone who is suffering from shame and public humiliation needs to know one thing: You can survive it.
sentences.zh: 这不仅仅是自我救赎。任何遭受耻辱和公开羞辱的人都应该知道这点：你能撑过去。

sentences.en: I know it's hard. It may not be painless, quick or easy, but you can insist on a different ending to your story.
sentences.zh: 我知道这很难。可能会很痛苦，漫长和艰难，但是你可以坚持下去， 并为你的故事改写不同的结局。

sentences.en: Have compassion for yourself. We all deserve compassion and to live both online and off in a more compassionate world.
sentences.zh: 同情自己，我们都值得同情。无论网络上还是生活中， 我们都需要活在一个更富有同情心的世界。

sentences.en: Thank you for listening. (Applause and cheers)
sentences.zh: 谢谢聆听。（掌声）
